name: Transfer Instruction 1
definition: Provides further information required for the account switch.

TransferIndicator.name: Transfer Indicator
TransferIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a payment arrangement is transferable.||Usage: Default value for TransferIndicator is false.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Specifies an additional parameter to be applied to the requested transaction schedule.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Specifies an additional parameter to be applied to the transaction schedule in a proprietary format.

StartDateTime.name: Start Date Time
StartDateTime.definition: The date and time at which the event specified by Code commences.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: The date on which the event specified by Code commences.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Additional switch parameters in a free text format.
